item.text: {"search_note":"I found no strong 2024 evidence of direct military mobilization relevant to this lens. The usable record is mostly about coalition management, bureaucracy, budget execution, election machinery, and information control. That means the strongest judgment here rests on state/party/bureaucratic mobilization, not military command.","evidence":[{"title":"India’s president invited Modi to form a coalition government after
